## TRA Timeline

#### Pre-IPO reorganization and TRA execution

- 2025-10-22: Private Placement Reorganization completes; TRA executed between Grayscale Investments, Inc., Grayscale Operating, LLC, the Pre-IPO LLC Members, and DCG Grayscale Holdco, LLC as TRA Party Representative
- 2025-10-27: DRS/A first files the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.3
- 2025-11-13: S-1 re-files the executed TRA (identical text) as Exhibit 10.3
- 2026-01-29: S-1/A incorporates Exhibit 10.3 by reference; body language confirms the TRA is now executed (past tense, 85% rate filled in)

## Explanation

Grayscale's TRA originated at the October 22, 2025 Private Placement Reorganization that established the company's Up-C structure ahead of its planned IPO. The contract obligates Grayscale Investments, Inc. to pay 85% of cash tax savings to the Pre-IPO LLC Members (DCG-affiliated holders, with named beneficiaries on a confidential-treatment-protected Annex), covering Section 754 basis step-ups on exchanges or deemed acquisitions of Grayscale Operating LLC units plus imputed-interest deductions on TRA payments. The Early Termination Rate is the lesser of 6.5% per annum and a SOFR-linked alternative. The TRA is executed and operative; the IPO close 8-K has not yet appeared in this directory and a future re-run should check for any joinder or amendment at closing. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record.
